title: Allowed polynomial fractions form a K-subalgebra
statement: Let K and F be fields with a K-algebra structure on F. Let x in F be transcendental over K and let q in K[T] be monic and irreducible. There is a K-subalgebra A of F whose elements are exactly the fractions a(x)/b(x) with a,b in K[T] and q not dividing b. No rational-generation hypothesis on F is required.
lean_statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (x : F), Transcendental K x → ∀ q : Polynomial K, q.Monic → Irreducible q → ∃ A : Subalgebra K F, ∀ f : F, f ∈ A ↔ ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ b ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b
